item.title: Naira extends appreciation against US dollar
item.description: The naira extended appreciation against the dollar at the official foreign exchange market on Wednesday. The Central Bank of Nigeria’s data showed that the Naira further firmed up on Wednesday to N1,418.26 per dollar, up from N1,419.07 exchanged on Tuesday.
